description: This file defines a set of React functional components representing inline SVG icons for use in a frontend application. It includes a base icon component and several specific icon components such as IconLayout, IconWallet, and others, each rendering different SVG paths. The components are exported for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: IconBase({ children, title, ...props })
methods.description: A reusable React component that provides the common SVG structure and accessibility features for all icon components.
